## 2. FOSS / Open-Weight LMs & Tools

- **Date:** 2026-06-29  
  **Link:** [DeepSeek DeepSpec collection on Hugging Face](https://huggingface.co/collections/deepseek-ai/deepspec)  
  **Summary:** DeepSeek published a DeepSpec collection of 12 small open-weight draft/speculative-decoding models for Qwen3 and Gemma4 backbones, including dspark, dflash, and eagle3 variants. Listed weights are BF16 safetensors in roughly the 0.9B-3B parameter range; model cards and hosted inference appear absent.  
  **Why it matters:** This is infrastructure, not a new frontier model: it targets faster inference via speculative decoding for existing open model families.
